newsitem.title: INDONESIA: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 20.
newsitem.headline: INDONESIAN STOCKS - factors to watch - March 20.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Indonesian stocks on Thursday:
* On Thursday, the Dow Jones industrial average lost 18.88 points to 6,877.68, after falling 70 points earlier in the session, as long-term interest rates rose near the key 7 percent level.

* Agriculture Minister Sjarifudin Baharsjah denied claims the government was assiting a large business group to monopolise the oil palm business in Indonesia by freeing new foreign investment in the sector, the Jakarta Post reported.
* On Wednesday, the Jakarta composite index closed 3.73 points higher at 663.17 points.
* On Thursday, the rupiah was quoted at 2,405.50/05.80 at 0145 GMT, compared with an opening of 2,405.00/06.00
* Telkom after rebounding overnight in London and New York.
* Trading firm Sekar Laut on market talk of a possible rights.
* Fishery firm Daya Guna Samudra on reports that President Suharto's son Bambang Trihatmodjo, who controls the Bimantara group, was likely to acquire large stake in the firm.
* Transportation firm Mitra Rajasa on market talk that business tycoon Yopie Widjaja planned to acquire the firm. Widjadja has denied the rumours.
